body:
MediaDive ingredient `1944` has a blank name and is reused for yeast-extract, Trypticase-peptone and MES stocks. This worker01 canary traces the exact frozen case to original JCM recipes, preserves all original fields, and records a malformed-source disposition with no MIM owner or mapping proposal.

Depends on #1158 at frozen base `e000d66dd26ab053e9b17ce7bf8d3c873c3dde99`; targets `curate/kgm-unmapped-chemicals-20261107`. This is an evidence-only canary PR for coordinator verification. [KG-Microbe #1824](https://github.com/Knowledge-Graph-Hub/kg-microbe/issues/1824) tracks the deduplicated source correction. [MIM #1159](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/issues/1159) separately tracks the three corrected and re-reviewed artifact findings (IR-DRAFT-1, IR-DRAFT-2 and IR-VALIDATION-1), with corrections and evidence in `review-dispositions.json`. No merge or release approval is requested.

- Scope: one exact source case from worker01's 188-case shard; the other 187 cases remain outside this phase.
- Evidence: frozen and live MediaDive bodies, original JCM recipes, contradicted ChEBI cross-reference, live issue/comment searches, explicit source repair requirements, and separate in-process skeptical review with resolved draft findings.
- Validation: Python 3.13 structural outcome audit and exact source accounting; SHA256 verification of 14,406 file-content hashes: 14,405 Git regular files plus the dereferenced CLAUDE.md file-symlink target. Both tracked symlink targets (`.agents/skills` and `CLAUDE.md`) separately match baseline Git blobs; exact proof is retained at `captures/coordinator-mim-preservation-v2.json` in the evidence bundle. Native data/export generation and data QC gates were not run because no maintained data or publication surface changed. No skipped check is represented as a pass. Full staged `git diff --check` reports preserved source HTML/header whitespace (exit 2); authored artifacts pass their scoped check, and captured primary bytes are not reformatted.
- Native review limitation: the current configured MIM routes do not cover this source-only no-owner assessment; the campaign's source-only exception applies. Generic snapshot serialization is supported by the shared schema, but no native ingredient review is claimed.
- Limits: no supplier SKU inferred, no global identity assigned to1944, no current KG endpoint defect asserted, and no inherited WITHHOLD/REJECTED/source-material hold removed. Independent review is by a separate Codex agent, not human scientific sign-off.

The complete bundle is `reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-01/canary/`, beginning with `report.md`, `decisions.json`, `evidence.json`, `proposals.json`, `progress.json`, `validation/` and the SHA256 manifest. Actual published head/check status is captured separately in the worker's durable completion receipt after PR creation, avoiding a self-referential commit hash. The worker stops for coordinator verification after this bounded canary.
title: Canary evidence: worker01 MediaDive 1944 source-only disposition
